label.zh: 追寻遗迹
label.en: Following the traces

note.zh: 9处调查地点没有固定先后，也不必全部完成；每处为“异常→发现→考古项目→报告”。累计六份线索（含先驱者补充线索）后定位母星系。
note.en: The 9 sites have no fixed order and need not all be done; each runs anomaly → discovery → dig project → report. Six clues (supplementary precursor clues count too) locate the home system.

label.zh: 母星调查的两种结果
label.en: Two outcomes of the homeworld survey

note.zh: 母星项目完成时只进入其中一种，不会先后发生。
note.en: Completing the homeworld project leads to exactly one of these; they never follow each other.

precursor.536.en: Two cryo chambers and medical logs

anomalies:yuht_2_cat.zh: 遗迹迹象：尤特监听哨站

anomalies:yuht_9_cat.zh: 遗迹迹象：尤特小行星居所

anomalies:YUHTAAN.zh: 未使用的母星异常定义

notes.zh: 开场：非AI帝国的科研船勘察一颗位于尤特星域（引擎分配的precursor_2星系）的行星（非恒星、无异常）时，on_survey_planet随机事件以权重6抽中；要求尚无任何先驱者开场。立即开始事件链并设置开场标志，此后调查异常才会生成。
notes.en: Opening: drawn (weight 6) from on_survey_planet random events when a non-AI empire's science ship surveys a planet (not a star, no anomaly) in a precursor_2 system allocated to the Yuht; the empire must have no other precursor intro. It begins the chain and sets the intro flag that the site anomalies need.

notes.zh: 每份报告给线索计数+1；满六份后，首个定位者生成母星系（无可用位置则每30天重试）并在2天后收到此通知；若他国已生成该星系，也在2天后收到。回应结束遗迹事件链，开启母星事件链和母星项目。
notes.en: Each report adds one clue; at six, the first empire to finish spawns the home system (retrying every 30 days if no spot is usable) and gets this notice 2 days later; if the system already exists, the notice also comes after 2 days. The response ends the site chain and opens the homeworld chain and project.

notes.zh: 基础30天，需要带科学家的科研船。完成时若全局母星发现标志尚未设置且目标不是殖民地，进入首次调查报告，否则进入“他人已先到”。
notes.en: Base 30 days, needs a science ship with a scientist. On completion: no global homeworld-found flag and an uncolonised target → first survey report; otherwise → someone else got there first.

notes.zh: 仅向观察者显示的通知（observer_event），不是玩家帝国的事件窗口。
notes.en: Shown only to observers (observer_event); not a window for the player's empire.

notes.zh: 此异常类别生成权重为0，没有脚本放置它；母星系初始化器对母星设置prevent_anomaly。当前版本中不会出现，这条研究路线不会实际发生。
notes.en: Spawn weight 0 and no script places it; the home-system initializer sets prevent_anomaly on the homeworld. It does not occur in the current game.

notes.zh: 另行花费750稀有文物开启，要求已发现尤特母星且尚未开始该研究。社会学项目无期限；完成报告按思潮与科技资格显示互斥正文和奖励回应。
notes.en: Spend 750 minor artifacts separately after finding the Yuht homeworld, provided this research has not already been started. The society project has no expiration. Its report and reward depend on ethics and technology eligibility.

label.zh: 主线结局：率先调查母星
label.en: Main ending: first to survey the homeworld

note.zh: 结束调查事件链，获得奖励与遗珍（远古遗物），并解锁可选的秘密研究。
note.en: Ends the investigation chain with rewards and a relic (Ancient Relics), unlocking the optional secrets research.

label.zh: 主线结局：他人已先到
label.en: Main ending: someone else got there first

note.zh: 母星已被他人调查；仍会解锁可选的秘密研究。
note.en: The homeworld was already surveyed by others; the optional secrets research is still unlocked.

scope.zh: 整条故事已逐项对照源码：开场触发与条件、全部调查异常（生成条件）、发现事件、考古项目、报告与线索计数、母星系定位路由、母星项目两种互斥结果、可选秘密研究及其后续、观察者通知与未使用的母星异常定义；中英文正文已通读。
scope.en: Whole story checked against source: opening trigger and conditions, every site anomaly (spawn conditions), discovery events, dig projects, reports and clue counter, home-system routing, the two exclusive homeworld outcomes, the optional secrets research and its follow-ups, the observer notice and the unused homeworld anomaly; Chinese and English text read.

uncertain: on_survey_planet random_events only weigh events whose trigger passes (comment at events/precursor_events.txt:5807); the per-survey chance of the opening therefore depends on which other events are eligible and is not stated as a percentage.
Rewards, relics and the secrets artifact action are gated by Ancient Relics (has_ancrel / minor artifacts); the no-DLC experience was read from script, not checked in game.
over.60 calls generate_lcluster_clue (L-Cluster clue, Distant Stars); the cross-chain effect is linked as an external story (distar.10904) and not reviewed here.
